task.title: To Create and Configure the On Call Contacts
task.shortdesc: This topic explains how to create and configure the OnCallContacts based on priority. An OnCallContact represents a pairing between the user and a contact method such as "text Valentina" or "send Armond an email". When an alarm is raised in the station based on the configuration, onCall contacts the particular user and the user receives a notification via email or SMS.

prereq.p: The user must be an existing user configured in the UserService for the selected contact method. For instance, if you select an EmailRecipient, that user must have an email address configured in the station.
The AlarmRecipient for the desired contact method should be configured in the AlarmService.

step.cmd: To create a new OnCallContacts, do one of the following.

choices.choice: In the Nav tree, expand OnCallService, right-click on any one of the OnCallLists and choose ViewsOn Call Contact Manager.
In the On Call List Manager view, double-click any one of the OnCallList.

step.stepresult: The On Call Contact Manager view opens.

step.cmd: To create a new OnCallContact, click New.
In the New window, configure the following parameters to select the user to contact and the contact method to use and click OK.

substep.cmd: Enabled - Activates (true) and deactivates (false) contact method.
Priority - Enter the desired priority level in which contacts are selected from the OnCallList.
User - Select the user from the drop-down list that has a configured contact method (email or SMS).
User Alarm Recipient - Select the contact method (EmailRecipient or SMSRecipient) to use to contact the user.

step.stepresult: Creates a new OnCallContact with the desired contact method in the On Call Contact Manager view.
